summary: P2 batch re-test after the dev_os_presence schema fix — ALL GREEN. The three previously-failing WS tests (happy-path roster, bad-token 4401, wrong-project 4403) plus audit-log, ws-token, and Mailgun module tests now pass (6/6). Frontend /dev-os/projects/{pid} loads cleanly: the wss://…/api/ws/dev-os-presence/{pid}?token=… handshake completes (Playwright captured the WS upgrade), zero 403 errors and zero pageerrors in the browser console. presence-bubbles testid is correctly absent when the user is alone (PresenceBubbles returns null on empty peers — by design and called out in the request). MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS=8 cap is in place so the prior infinite-retry pollution is no longer possible even if the WS were to fail.
critical_code_review_comments: dev_os_presence.presence_ws now correctly resolves workspace memberships via db.workspace_members + scalar users.workspace_id — matches the canonical pattern used by deps.get_user. Schema-regression risk removed.

Reminder from iter 59 still valid: pre-accept WebSocket close codes (4401/4403/4404) never reach the browser — Starlette always emits HTTP 403 on the upgrade. If the frontend ever needs to distinguish causes, the backend would need to accept() first, send a typed error event, then close. Today the cap-at-8 reconnect makes this acceptable.

useDevOsPresence MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS=8 + exponential backoff capped at 30s is good. One micro-nit: reconnectAttempts.current is post-incremented inside Math.min on both success/failure branches; semantics are identical to the previous unbounded version + a hard cap, so behavior is correct.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration59_p2batch.py — updated the 4401/4403 tests to import websockets.exceptions.InvalidStatus (new in websockets>=14, replaces deprecated InvalidStatusCode). Without this the tests would raise an uncaught InvalidStatus on the 403 HTTP response from the ingress and report a false negative.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (page loads, WS handshake succeeds, no console errors)

context_for_next_testing_agent: WS presence fix is verified; reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration59_p2batch.py as a regression. websockets lib in this env is 16.0 — use websockets.exceptions.InvalidStatus (not InvalidStatusCode) when asserting handshake rejection. Frontend test for presence-bubbles testid being visible requires two concurrent peers; the testid is correctly null when a single user views the project (PresenceLayer.jsx line 72: `if (!peers || peers.length === 0) return null;`).
rca of the issue: Backend bug already fixed by main agent (workspace_ids → workspace_members + scalar workspace_id). Test-side residual issue: websockets 16.0 raises InvalidStatus (not the deprecated InvalidStatusCode) when the server returns HTTP 403 on the upgrade. The original tests only caught InvalidStatusCode so the exception escaped and the tests appeared to fail even though the backend behavior was correct. Fixed by catching whichever class exists in the installed websockets version.
